channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dorian Finney-Smith | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dorian Finney-Smith from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Kevin Durant:

“Attack the paint, try to get layups, try to get threes. But when it's five to six seconds on the clock, give the ball to the best player. And if you shoot a mid-range at that point, then he's shooting a mid-range. Butwe not going to waste the clock trying to look for a three with two seconds on the clock, and we giving it to no Dorian Finney-Smith with two seconds on the clock to make a three.”

Kevin Durant on Dorian Finney-Smith, Jul 2, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Pacers coach Rick Carlisle on DFS:

“Dorian Finney-Smith is one of my favorite players (I’ve coached). He’s a quintessential three and D guy, but he’s more than that, because he’s a better playmaker and passer than you think, and does a lot of nuanced things. As a teammate, he was one of the guys Luka really trusted in Dallas.”

Rick Carlisle on Dorian Finney-Smith, Mar 26, 2025. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Marcus Morris on Maxi Kleber, Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Marcus said at the 7:32 mark.

“So I think that they probably noticed that and they wanted Luka to feel better going to a new place where you have somebody who has been a teammate. Also Dorian Finney-Smith has been [Doncic's teammate]. Maxi Kleber. So I think that really helped. Also ‘Kieff played there, so the Lakers really wanted him to come. ‘Bron asked for him to come.”

Marcus Morris on Maxi Kleber, Dorian Finney-Smith, Mar 24, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on the Dorian Finney-Smith trade:

“It was very simple that if we had that maturity and that thoughnsss we would’ve closed this game.”

Jordi Fernandez on Dorian Finney-Smith, Dec 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on Finney-Smith:

“Sometimes you’ve gotta save him from himself. It's good to have him on the court, and obviously we don't want him to miss games, so we'll do whatever it takes to take care of his body.”

Jordi Fernandez on Dorian Finney-Smith, Dec 26, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kevin Ollie on Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Kevin Ollie on Dorian Finney-Smith getting to play in front of his dad for 1st time:

“I know it's gonna be significant for him and he's gonna handle it like a pro...go out & do his job. But I imagine you have some special joy inside for his dad to watch him finally play.”

Kevin Ollie on Dorian Finney-Smith, Apr 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Vince Carter on Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
“So now, who is going to guard the other? That’s the problem. Finney-Smith isn’t a superstar, but he’s a gem. He’s a guy that will knock down a shot, and he’s going to guard their best player and he’s going to take the pressure off Luka having to guard somebody.”

Vince Carter on Dorian Finney-Smith, Apr 25, 2023. Source: Fort Worth Star-Telegram.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Spencer Dinwiddie on Nets acquiring Dorian Finney-Smith in the Kyrie Irving trade:

“When they (Nets) called and asked about him, I told them that’s not going to be a guy you want to lose. He’s a guy that defends one through five… I ain’t met a guy he can’t guard outside of me.”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Dorian Finney-Smith, Feb 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Big Sean on Spencer Dinwiddie, Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
“We’re excited to add Spencer and Dorian to our roster, while also securing draft compensation that will increase our flexibility moving forward,”

Big Sean on Spencer Dinwiddie, Dorian Finney-Smith, Feb 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @AdamZagoria.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
“You can work for Google, Apple, any great company and people don’t pay attention in the community. But when you’re a professional athlete like Dorian, people want to know that you care and Doe-Doe exemplifies that. He’s just a special guy.”

Mark Cuban on Dorian Finney-Smith, Aug 3, 2022. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Callie Caplan:Jason Kidd on Dorian Finney-Smith's 8-of-12 from three day:

“When he's playing like that, when he's not hesitating and catch-and-shoot, he's as good as anyone.”

Jason Kidd on Dorian Finney-Smith, May 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @CallieCaplan.

item.title: Monty Williams on Reggie Bullock, Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Monty Williams:

“Finney-Smith is one of the most improved players in the NBA. Doesn't get nearly enough credit for that . . . Bullock is a guy that New York talked about how much they didn't want to lose him and now everybody out in the West is wishing he would have stayed.”

Monty Williams on Reggie Bullock, Dorian Finney-Smith, May 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on the status of Finney-Smith for tomorrow's home game vs. Memphis:

“I think there's a good chance you'll see him tomorrow. It's not 100 percent, but I think it's better than 50-50.”

Rick Carlisle on Dorian Finney-Smith, Apr 4, 2019. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Dwain Price:Rick Carlisle on Dorian Finney-Smith:

“He’ll play tonight and will likely not play tomorrow night for injury recovery management. With Wes (Matthews) out we need guys like him that can guard the (DeMar) DeRozans of the world, which is extremely difficult.”

Rick Carlisle on Dorian Finney-Smith, Mar 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Josh McRoberts, Seth Curry, Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Eddie Sefko:Rick Carlisle on injured Mavericks like Seth Curry, Dorian Finney-Smith, Josh McRoberts:

“We’re still hoping to get some guys back at some point. We’re just not sure what month. I’ve been wrong so far. Not December.”

Rick Carlisle on Josh McRoberts, Seth Curry, Dorian Finney-Smith, Dec 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @ESefko.
